summary:
iter239 — STOIC main101 Review verification. New test file backend/tests/integration/test_main101_review.py (7 tests, 7 PASSED, 0 FAILED, ~5s on live preview). All N101 deltas green:
  • N101-2 /api/admin/release-gate: 200, keys enforced/ok/failures/lock_commit/accounts; in preview enforced=false and every account row has account_id/label/environment/allowed/reason, allowed=true, reason='release gate enforced in production only' (verified against 50 accounts).
  • N101-5 /api/infra/artifacts/manifest: signature.purpose='artifact-manifest', key_id present, value is 128 hex chars; Ed25519 verifies with b'stoic:artifact-manifest:v1\0' + canonical JSON of {artifacts,update_policy} (json sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), default=str) using signature.public_key_b64; does NOT verify with b'stoic:ea-release:v1\0' prefix.
  • N101-7 /api/health/release: release_identity.ea_signed_record is boolean (false in preview, no signed record on disk); release_identity.image_digest present; release_identity.ea_shipped_version=='1.60'.
  • N101-5 /api/ops/deploy-preflight: checks[] contains id 'release_signer_token_scope' with status 'pass' (preview is RELEASE_SIGNER=local).
  • POST /api/public/performance/verify: domain_prefix=='stoic:differentiation:v1\0' + public_key_b64 present.
  • Acceptance: GET /api/admin/acceptance/current 200 (accounts[]); POST /api/admin/acceptance/bundle NEVER returns 500 (observed 503 bundle_unavailable in preview — acceptable).
  • FRONTEND /: data-testid='testimonials-pause-button' present with aria-pressed='false'; after click aria-pressed='true' AND data-testid='testimonials-marquee' gets data-paused='true'; the role=region marquee has NO aria-pressed attribute (N101-7 fix verified).
  • FRONTEND /admin/demo-readiness (admin@trading.bot): data-testid='release-gate-row' + 'release-gate-accounts' render; 50 li with data-testid starting 'release-gate-account-'; first li text 'Start Trader · LIVE: allowed — release gate enforced in production only' matches the required ': allowed'/': blocked' pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/vps_pathb.py L498-507 + backend/release_channels.py L117-120: canonical body is dumps({artifacts, update_policy}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), default=str).encode() AND signed with purpose='artifact-manifest' — matches the pin exactly; manifest.signature.key_id is bound to the artifact-manifest purpose (not reused across EA-release). N101-5 domain-separation is enforced in release_signing.verify_hex (purpose kwarg is REQUIRED), so an EA-release signature can never satisfy an artifact-manifest verification path.

backend/routes/admin_routes.py L178-204 admin_release_gate: per-account enumeration respects attested_environment() + is_production(); reason text is deterministic and matches the frontend testid key 'release-gate-account-<id>' (50 rows rendered without truncation of the ul data-testid tree).

backend/deploy_preflight.py L181-190 release_signer_token_scope: correctly flips to 'fail' only when RELEASE_SIGNER_TOKEN leaks onto the API host and mode=external; returns 'pass' in local mode (preview) which matches the review requirement.

backend/server.py L265-280 health_release: image_digest + ea_shipped_version live under release_identity (NOT at the top level). If an external caller still expects top-level keys that would be a doc-only mismatch — not a bug, since the review bullet explicitly points at release_identity.ea_signed_record under the same object.

frontend/src/components/LandingTestimonials.jsx L214-223: aria-pressed is now on the <button data-testid='testimonials-pause-button'>, not on the role=region marquee — the region keeps aria-roledescription='carousel' and tabIndex=0 for Space/Enter toggling. ARIA contract is clean.
test_credentials: Read from TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env (backend/.env preview). NEVER written to any file under /app. Preview password is listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only probes against preview DB (ai_trading_bot). No TEST_ rows created or left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_main101_review.py is self-contained: credentials from env, cryptography lib for Ed25519 verification of the artifact manifest, uses /api/public/performance/verify (NOT /api/performance/attestation/verify — that path does not exist, the public verifier is at public_router prefix='/public'). release-gate assertions assume preview (enforced=false); for a production run, update the TestReleaseGateAccounts expectations (allowed per attested environment). Frontend coverage verified via Playwright on the Vite preview — pause button + release-gate rows both ship with the required data-testid attributes.
rca of the issue: No product bugs observed in the main101 N101 scope. Two test authoring adjustments were made (field location under release_identity; correct public verifier path at /api/public/performance/verify) — both are test-only; no backend code was modified.
